LanguageData.SZ_AnomaliesShiftedText: The emission has passed and the anomaly field has changed. The old anomalies are gone and new ones have formed elsewhere, possibly holding fresh artifacts.
LanguageData.SZ_ShelterOrdered: Emission approaching: colonists are heading for shelter. Drafted colonists stay where you put them.
LanguageData.SZ_CannotAttackAnomaly: An anomaly can't be attacked: it has no body to hit. Go around it.
LanguageData.SZ_RadiationSignTip:
Radiation hazard sign.
Marks the edge of contaminated ground. Staying inside causes radiation sickness.
LanguageData.SZ_ThrowBoltDesc: Throw a bolt at a nearby cell. An anomaly there discharges and stays highlighted for a while; otherwise the way is clear.
LanguageData.SZ_BoltTooFar: Too far to throw a bolt.
LanguageData.SZ_BeltDesc: Pick up an artifact into the belt (inventory). Active artifacts: as many as the suit's belt slots.
LanguageData.SZ_UseRepairKitDesc: Spend one repair kit from the inventory to restore 40% of this suit's durability. A worn suit protects worse.
LanguageData.SZ_NoRepairKit: No repair kit in the inventory.
LanguageData.SZ_SuitNoRoom: {0}: no room for upgrade "{1}", the materials were wasted.
